body: Owner, 2026-10-08: "just do the recommend for now", choosing "The 3 open decisions (Recommended)". contrib/svg/raster keeps github.com/srwiley/oksvg (pure Go, CGO_ENABLED=0) as its default renderer; a wasm resvg renderer is not built. Apps needing text or filters pass their own Renderer through raster.Options, as the README already documents. Revisit if oksvg breaks on a Go release or a user needs full SVG fidelity; resvg would then be a separate opt-in module.
title: Default SVG renderer stays oksvg
